notes.title: Animated wallpapers
notes.content:
Hi! We've created a set of animated wallpapers in Wallpaper Engine with in-game art and music.
Hope you will like it :)

notes.title: Comic book as a free DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30709366/45ead90539e829e5d03bf28986a955ab8a309843.png[/img]

This book is a free DLC, so check you Metropolis page in Steam Library, DLC block in the right panel. PDF file will be next to the game after installing this DLC (browse local files to find it). 

Is it the same story? Yes and no, as book format requires a linear plot.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1025400

Leave your comments, thanks for support!
